name: @molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official
description: Official MolVis plugin collection meta. Plain semver. Children keep independent versions.

scripts.dev: npm run pack:molvis-src && rsbuild build --watch & trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npx --yes serve -l ${PORT:-4173} --cors .
scripts.build:self: npm run pack:molvis-wheel && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && rsbuild build
scripts.build: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present build || F=1; done; npm run build:self || F=1; exit $F
scripts.typecheck: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present typecheck || F=1; done; npm run typecheck:self || F=1; exit $F
scripts.test: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present test || F=1; npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present test:py || F=1; done; npm run test:self || F=1; exit $F
scripts.check:manifests: node -e "const f=require('fs'),m=p=>JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(p)),cmp=(a,b)=>{const x=(a||'').replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'').split('.').map(Number),y=(b||'').replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'').split('.').map(Number);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if((x[i]||0)!==(y[i]||0))return (x[i]||0)-(y[i]||0);}return 0;},dirs=f.readdirSync('plugins').filter(d=>f.existsSync('plugins/'+d+'/molvis.plugin.json'));let b=[];for(const d of ['.',...dirs.map(d=>'plugins/'+d)]){const a=m(d+'/molvis.plugin.json'),p=m(d+'/package.json');if(a.version!==p.version)b.push(d+': manifest '+a.version+' != package.json '+p.version);}const root=m('./molvis.plugin.json').molvis;for(const d of dirs){const c=m('plugins/'+d+'/molvis.plugin.json').molvis;if(cmp(c,root)>0)b.push('plugins/'+d+' needs molvis '+c+', collection declares '+root+' — the collection embeds it');}if(b.length){console.error(b.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}console.log('manifests ok');"
scripts.check: npm run check:manifests && npm run check:official-plugins && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:py && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.lint:py: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present lint:py || F=1; done; exit $F
scripts.verify:bundle: F=0; for d in . plugins/*; do [ -f "$d/dist/plugin.js" ] && node --check "$d/dist/plugin.js" || { echo "bad bundle: $d"; F=1; }; done; for d in . plugins/pyodide-molpy; do grep -q kernelRuntime "$d/rsbuild.config.ts" 2>/dev/null || continue; for a in coincident.worker.js all.json piplite-0.8.2-py3-none-any.whl; do [ -f "$d/dist/$a" ] || { echo "missing kernel runtime asset: $d/dist/$a"; F=1; }; done; ls "$d/dist"/molcrafts_molvis-*.whl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "missing molvis wheel in $d/dist (run pack:molvis-wheel)"; F=1; }; done; exit $F
scripts.check:official-plugins: node -e "const f=require('fs'),dirs=f.readdirSync('plugins').filter(d=>f.existsSync('plugins/'+d+'/package.json')).sort(),src=f.readFileSync('src/version.ts','utf8'),m=src.match(/OFFICIAL_PLUGINS[^=]*=\\s*\\[([^\\]]*)\\]/);if(!m){console.error('OFFICIAL_PLUGINS not found in src/version.ts');process.exit(1);}const listed=[...m[1].matchAll(/\"([^\"]+)\"/g)].map(x=>x[1]).sort();if(JSON.stringify(listed)!==JSON.stringify(dirs)){console.error('OFFICIAL_PLUGINS '+JSON.stringify(listed)+' != plugins/* '+JSON.stringify(dirs));process.exit(1);}console.log('OFFICIAL_PLUGINS matches plugins/*');"
